title: Existing graph-normalized finite smooth adjunction coordinates and diagonal map
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on schemes of universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Define $\mathrm{FiniteSmoothCompactSupportComparisons}(A)$ to be families $N_{e,c}:Rr_*Dj_!\simeq D(e_{\Sigma!})$ for every separated etale quasi-compact morphism $e:V\to T$ of finite type between Noetherian schemes and every compactification $c=(j,r)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], using actual compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. Define $\mathrm{FiniteSmoothComparisonNormalized}(A,N)$ to require a simultaneous family of sheaf maps $a_{e,c}:e_{\Sigma!}\to r_*j_!$ whose composite into $e_*$ is the graph-extension sum-to-direct-image map and whose degreewise descent followed by the total right-derived unit equals $N_{e,c}^{-1}$ on every homotopy representative. This is precisely the graph and representative normalization portion of [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], without its further refinement or base-change clauses, and asserts no existence. For finite $A$ and compactifiable such $e$, define $\mathrm{finiteSmoothSumComparison}$ by the fixed comparison at the selected compactification. Define $\rho_e=\mathrm{finiteSmoothAdjointCoordinates}:e_A^\times\simeq Le^*$ by right-adjoint uniqueness between the actual compact-support adjunction [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] and the degreewise sum-extension/inverse-image adjunction; use the canonical identification of exact inverse image with its left-derived functor [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Define $\mathrm{finiteSmoothOmegaCoordinates}$ by evaluating $\rho_e$ at $A_T$ and applying the inverse-image unit comparison; define $\mathrm{finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates}$ by pulling this isomorphism back along any $s:T\to V$ and using the same unit comparison. For any compactifiable quasi-compact $f:X\to Y$, put $W=X\times_YX$ with projections $p_1,p_2$ and diagonal $\Delta$. Define $\mathrm{finiteSmoothDiagonalFactor}:\omega_f\to\Delta^*\omega_{p_1}$ as the inverse section compositor $\omega_f\to\Delta^*p_2^*\omega_f$ followed by $\Delta^*$ of the counit-defined exceptional base-change map [prop-asd-smooth-base-change]. Finally, $\mathrm{finiteSmoothPullbackNoetherian}$ packages the Noetherian structure on $X\times_YX$ when $X$ is Noetherian and $f$ is locally of finite type and quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme]. All these operations are existing definitions; no smooth-purity or dimension-zero normalization theorem is asserted.
